prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original full-body HUMAN POSTMAN character sprite for Magic Mail, a playful magical postal adventure game. Genuine TRANSPARENT alpha background. Single character only, complete from hat to boots, generous transparent margin. Character design direction: expressive 1990s cartoon platformer energy, bold irregular shapes, strong asymmetric silhouette, exaggerated angular anatomy, elastic stylish proportions and appealing confident attitude. Clearly an ADULT young man, NOT chibi, NOT a baby, NOT a cute big-headed child. Around 6 heads tall: relatively small head, long lanky arms and legs, narrow angular waist, broad sloping shoulders, oversized irregular gloves and big differently angled boots. Original human design, not Crash Bandicoot himself, no animal muzzle or orange fur. Face: angular cheekbones, prominent crooked nose, expressive uneven eyebrows, lively green eyes of normal cartoon size, mischievous crooked smile, swept unruly auburn hair with three pointed tufts sticking out from a tilted purple postal cap. Costume: vivid coral-red long postal jacket with asymmetric flared tails and broad angular lapels, turquoise scarf with two unequal tails, violet cap with a small attached gold envelope badge, navy narrow trousers, chunky warm brown postal boots, cream gloves. A worn warm-gold mail satchel worn diagonally, with two visible cream envelopes securely sticking out of its flap, no floating mail. Pose: relaxed welcoming swagger, weight on one long leg, other boot angled outward, one very long arm extending in an open welcoming gesture toward the RIGHT, the other hand holding the satchel strap. Clean readable silhouette, feet grounded at the same baseline. Style: hand-drawn 2D game illustration, broad simple saturated color shapes with smooth luminous gradients, restrained glossy curved highlights, colorful shadows, thin continuous ivory-white OUTER outline. Details concentrated in face and silhouette, no tiny surface texture, no realistic rendering, no sculpted toy/plastic 3D appearance. No scenery, floor plane, detached shadow, text, labels, logos or extra characters.
